premise: Duckling sees the moon floating in the pond and tries to scoop it up — it wobbles away every time; Owl wakes and tells him to look up, Firefly adds a second little light to the water, and Duckling falls asleep with the moon watching over him.
inspiration: The monkeys who tried to catch the moon in the well (Indian and Chinese folk), turned: nobody falls in, and the moon is loveliest left where it is — up in the sky and down in the pond at once.
lesson: Some lovely things are for looking at, not keeping.

en-US.title: Duckling Catches the Moon
en-US.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7 14s} [softly] The sun was going down. Up on a branch, {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Owl had slept all day, and he was {owl:live hold} still fast asleep. {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to pond} Duckling waddled over for one last paddle. {canvas:night 0.8 45s} Then up came the moon. {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] A moon IN the pond! I'll catch it! {duckling:go to pond another by swim} Off he paddled. He scooped with his beak… {sfx:splash} splish! The moon wobbled to pieces. {duckling:face sad} It came back. He tried again… {sfx:splash} SPLASH! Gone again. {owl:live resume} Owl opened one eye, then the other. {sfx:hoot} Hoo? What's all the splashing? {duckling:pulse} I'm catching the moon! {owl:face happy} [giggles] Look up, said Owl. {duckling:face happy} {duckling:hop x2} There it was! Up in the sky AND down in the pond! {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to pond} Firefly drifted down over the water and {firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A} glowed like a little lantern. Now there were two lights in the pond. {duckling:face sleeping} Duckling yawned, and {duckling:live hold} tucked his head under his wing. [whispers] And the moon stayed right where it was… and watched him sleep.

es-ES.title: Patito quiere coger la luna
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7 14s} [softly] El sol se estaba poniendo. En una rama, {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Búho había dormido todo el día, y {owl:live hold} seguía profundamente dormido. {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to pond} Patito llegó bamboleándose para darse un último chapuzón. {canvas:night 0.8 45s} Entonces salió la luna. {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] ¡Una luna DENTRO de la charca! ¡La voy a coger! {duckling:go to pond another by swim} Allá fue nadando. La intentó coger con el pico… {sfx:splash} ¡chof! La luna tembló en mil pedacitos. {duckling:face sad} Poco a poco, volvió. Lo intentó otra vez… {sfx:splash} ¡CHOF! Otra vez nada. {owl:live resume} Búho abrió un ojo, y luego el otro. {sfx:hoot} ¿Uuu? ¿Qué es tanto chapoteo? {duckling:pulse} ¡Estoy cogiendo la luna! {owl:face happy} [giggles] Mira arriba, dijo Búho. {duckling:face happy} {duckling:hop x2} ¡Allí estaba! ¡Arriba en el cielo Y abajo en la charca! {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to pond} Luciérnaga bajó volando sobre el agua y {firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A} brilló como un farolillo. Ahora había dos luces en la charca. {duckling:face sleeping} Patito bostezó y {duckling:live hold} escondió la cabeza bajo el ala. [whispers] Y la luna se quedó donde estaba… mirándolo dormir.

splash.prompt: a duckling's beak dipping into a still pond, a small soft splash, realistic
